## Change summary

Describe the user-visible or operational outcome.

## Self-review

- [ ] The locked build, checks, and boundary scanner pass from a clean install.
- [ ] No secret, private partner material, raw research, source master, or privileged legal record is present.
- [ ] Content is approved for its intended public release state; placeholders cannot reach production.
- [ ] Accessibility, privacy, rights/credits, security headers, and external links affected by this change were reviewed.
- [ ] The change stays within the approved MVP scope and cost categories.
- [ ] Rollback or removal behavior is understood for this change.
